pitches.name: Sofia
pitches.why: It's a farm animal that isn't eaten, so it fits the vegetarian café, and the owner used to keep one, which should make them happy. It's also cheerful and instantly recognisable with its long ears and friendly face.

pitches.name: Omar
pitches.why: A chick is small, friendly and cheerful, and everyone recognises it instantly, which fits a farm café window. Its round body and beak are also easy to read in dominoes.

pitches.name: Hana
pitches.why: The client's own hens wander among the tables and the kids love them, so it's cheerful, personal to the café, and instantly recognisable. A chicken's silhouette (comb, beak, round body, tail) should also read clearly in dominoes for blind judges.

pitches.name: Jack
pitches.why: The café is on a farm and famous for eggs and egg custard tarts, so a chicken ties straight to the client's brand, and it's cheerful and instantly recognisable even in domino form.
